description: Mint a NEW management token for a drop and kill the old one — the self-serve way out of a lost or leaked token. With the old token it goes through at once; with your connected account (recovery), a human confirms it: with a connected account this answers confirmation_required with an address; the owner opens it, sees exactly what you asked and confirms (passkey or email); then call again with the SAME arguments within 5 minutes. Works with the old token (rotation) or with your connected account for a drop you own (recovery: you lost the token, your account gets you a fresh one). The new token is returned ONCE, right here — store it. Every previously shared management link dies the moment this returns: that is the point when rotating a leaked token, and the cost to know when rotating a merely misplaced one.
name: dropyour_rotate_token
title: Rotate a drop's management token
